_help.about: Workspace config. "canvas" holds the chrome — edit its values, or delete a key entirely to fall back to the DaVinci default. "designSystem" and the optional "styleSources" are separate top-level keys.
styleSources: OPTIONAL, and absent by default — leave it out and the ux-writing skill probes for these once,
then caches what it found in <root>/style-sources.json. Declare it only to end the probe for good.
Add it as a TOP-LEVEL key beside "designSystem", not inside "canvas":
"asg":    "docs/style/apple-style-guide.pdf",   Apple Style Guide — a file it can read a rule out of
"hig":    "docs/design/hig/",                   Human Interface Guidelines — a file or a folder
Each source resolves independently: vendoring only the HIG is fine, and the other two fall back to
the distillations bundled with the skill. A repo copy always wins over the bundled one.
A house style guide is a DIFFERENT thing: put it at .davinci/.overrides/style/ and it outranks Apple entirely.
ribbon: enabled                 true | false      false removes the bar and its info modal
collapsible             true | false      adds the pull tab; the open/closed choice persists per browser
collapsedByDefault      true | false      ends up collapsed on a first visit — but shows the bar FIRST with a countdown, so the reviewer learns it exists. Needs collapsible; ignored without it
autoHideDelay           seconds           how long that countdown runs (default 5); 0 collapses instantly with no countdown
tabPosition             center|left|right where the pull tab sits; left/right align with the bar's own padding (default center)
background              CSS background    colour OR gradient: "#FFD06D", "var(--color-fill-yellow)", "linear-gradient(90deg, #2A7B9B 0%, #57C785 100%)"
textColor               any CSS colour    every label on the bar: message, info icon, chevron, Show Notes label. NOT the buttons (components; see buttonTextColor)
border                  true | false      draws a hairline under the bar (and around the tab). Off by default: it reads as a stray line on a dark or gradient bar
borderColor             any CSS colour    that hairline's colour; "" follows the design system's border grey. Only shows when border is true
buttonBackground        CSS background    the bar's buttons (Add Note / Change History / Live Editor); "" keeps the design system's own button look
buttonTextColor         any CSS colour    those buttons' label + icon; "" keeps the design system's own
buttonBorderColor       any CSS colour    those buttons' border; "" keeps the design system's own
notesBackground         CSS background    the notes group's fill; "" leaves it transparent so the bar shows through
notesTextColor          any CSS colour    the notes group's label + its three icons; "" follows textColor
notesBorderColor        any CSS colour    the notes group's frame; "" leaves it borderless (transparent), like the buttons
message                 HTML string       <strong>/<em> allowed; the info icon always renders
features.notes          true | false      the whole sticky-note system: Add Note + Show Notes + Copy Notes, and the notes' rich text, colour, resize, anchoring and delete guard
features.changeHistory  true | false      off switch only — the button still requires the prototype's changelog.json
features.liveEditor     true | false      Live Editor button (⌘I) — inspect any element's resolved design tokens and edit its styles in place
footer: left | center | right   HTML string       "" renders nothing; all three empty hides the footer
delete a key to restore the DaVinci default (only center has one)
navbar: enabled                 true | false      false removes the top bar entirely. Default true.
The bar simulates the product's top bar AND is how a reviewer
moves between the prototype's screens — hiding it removes that
navigation, so set false only for a product with no top bar
(a sidebar-nav app, a single full-screen tool).
